cards.limitations: 结果来自两模型家族的受控测量，加速与内存收益的具体幅度未必可外推到其他模型规模、数据或硬件配置。分支剪枝伴随略低的平均准确率，开放式评分随基准不同而变化，说明效率提升存在精度代价。条件无偏性针对单分支梯度估计，不等同于整体训练目标或最终模型质量无偏。
cards.originalTitle: Stochastic Pruning of the DPO Computation Graph: 1.4x Faster Training and Lower Peak Memory
cards.whyItMatters: DPO 的训练成本分布在输出打分、序列执行和反向传播多个阶段，仅减少监督信号未必节省计算。该工作提供了按阶段剪枝的系统框架，并把资源收益与目标函数变化对应起来，有助于研究者和工程师在理解精度代价的前提下评估 DPO 训练效率方案。
cards.descriptionEn: The study randomly samples and prunes response positions, response prefixes and preference branches in the DPO computation graph before the corresponding operations, skipping computation at each training stage. Its novelty lies in linking resource savings to changes in the training objective and using inverse-probability weighting for a conditionally unbiased single-branch gradient estimator, which is useful for practitioners concerned with DPO training efficiency.
cards.title: DPO 计算图随机剪枝：训练提速并降低峰值内存
cards.summaryEn: The authors propose a unified framework that independently samples response positions, response prefixes and preference branches of the DPO computation graph and selects them before the corresponding operations to omit computation. The analysis characterizes objective changes from position and sequence pruning and uses inverse-probability weighting to obtain a conditionally unbiased single-branch gradient estimator. Controlled measurements show position and sequence pruning mainly reduce peak memory, while branch pruning achieves a 1.426x step-time speedup over a concatenated DPO baseline.
keyPoints: 位置与序列剪枝主要减少峰值内存，大部分输出内存节省来自保留完整响应监督的实现。
分支剪枝相对拼接式 DPO 基线实现 1.426 倍单步加速，相对原版 DPO 训练时间约减少 30%。
框架在采样前完成选择，从而在打分、执行和反向传播各阶段跳过计算，并用逆概率加权维持条件无偏梯度估计。
cards.titleEn: Stochastic Pruning of the DPO Computation Graph: Faster Training and Lower Peak Memory
cards.whyItMattersEn: DPO training cost spans output scoring, sequence execution and backpropagation, so reducing supervision alone may not save computation. This work offers a staged pruning framework and relates resource benefits to objective changes, helping researchers and engineers assess DPO efficiency options while understanding accuracy trade-offs.
cards.description: 该研究把 DPO 训练中的输出打分、序列执行和反向传播三个环节分别随机采样并提前剪枝，从而在每一步训练中直接跳过部分计算。其新意在于将资源节省与目标函数变化联系起来，并用逆概率加权保证梯度估计条件无偏；对关心 DPO 训练效率的实践者具有参考价值。
cards.summary: 作者提出一个统一框架，对 DPO 计算图的响应位置、响应前缀和偏好分支独立随机采样，并在相应运算前完成选择以省略计算。分析刻画了位置与序列剪枝带来的目标变化，并用逆概率加权得到条件无偏的单分支梯度估计。受控测量显示位置与序列剪枝主要降低峰值内存，分支剪枝相对拼接式 DPO 基线取得 1.426 倍单步加速。
keyPointsEn: Position and sequence pruning mainly reduce peak memory, with most output-memory savings coming from an implementation that retains full response supervision.
Branch pruning yields a 1.426x step-time speedup over a concatenated DPO baseline and about 30% less training time than stock DPO.
The framework selects before sampling to skip computation in scoring, execution and backpropagation, using inverse-probability weighting to keep a conditionally unbiased gradient estimator.
cards.limitationsEn: Results come from controlled measurements across two model families; the specific speedup and memory gains may not generalize to other model scales, data or hardware. Branch pruning comes with slightly lower mean accuracy and benchmark-dependent changes in open-ended scores, indicating an accuracy cost for efficiency. Conditional unbiasedness applies to the single-branch gradient estimator, not to the overall training objective or final model quality.

cards.limitations: 证据仅来自 Polymarket 单一平台 2023 年 1 月至 2026 年 5 月的已结算市场，结论外推到其他平台或未结算市场需谨慎；争议预测精度过低，仅适合群体排序；交易量预测在平台格式变化后性能显著下降，模型稳定性受制度变化影响。
cards.originalTitle: What Prediction-Market Contracts Reveal at Launch: Trading Volume and Dispute Risk
cards.whyItMatters: 为预测市场设计者提供基于上线文本的早期风险筛查工具思路，并警示模型在平台规则变化时的脆弱性；对量化研究而言，强调了可解释特征与分布漂移评估的重要性。
cards.descriptionEn: Using a near-census of resolved Polymarket markets, this study predicts lifetime trading volume and settlement disputes solely from listing-time contract information (title, description, resolution source, metadata). It assesses interpretable features versus neural text models and documents performance degradation under platform change. The work offers a contract-text-based screening approach for market designers and researchers, but dispute prediction precision is too low fo
cards.title: 预测市场合约上线信息可预测交易量与争议风险
cards.summaryEn: Using a near-census of 802,863 resolved markets, the study shows that listing-time contract information predicts lifetime trading volume well (out-of-sample R²=0.747), with market topic contributing most; dispute risk can be ranked (AUC=0.78) but individual prediction is imprecise at a 0.31% base rate (average precision 0.012). The authors find that volume prediction performance drops sharply after a platform format change, with losses concentrated in question forms absent from training and attributed more to a changed relationship between contract characteristics and demand than to an outdated text-to-feature mapping. These findings are specific to one platform and period.
keyPoints: 上线时合约信息可解释交易量的大部分变异，市场主题是最强预测因子，措辞和解决规则设计有额外但较小的贡献。
争议风险预测具有排序能力（AUC 0.78），但在 0.31% 基率下平均精度仅 0.012，不适合个案预测。
平台格式变化导致交易量预测性能大幅下降（AUC 从 0.940 降至 0.577），损失集中于训练中未出现的问题形式。
cards.titleEn: Launch-Time Contract Information Predicts Trading Volume and Dispute Risk in Prediction Markets
cards.whyItMattersEn: Provides a contract-text-based early screening approach for prediction market designers and warns about model fragility under platform rule changes; for quantitative research, it highlights the importance of interpretable features and distribution-shift evaluation.
cards.description: 该研究利用 Polymarket 大量已结算市场，仅基于上线时的合约信息（标题、描述、解决源及元数据）预测终身交易量和结算争议。其新意在于系统评估可解释特征与神经文本模型的预测增益，并揭示平台变化时模型性能的衰减机制；有用性在于为市场设计者和研究者提供基于合约文本的风险筛选思路，但争议预测精度有限，仅适合排序分组。
cards.summary: 研究使用近普查数据（802,863 个已结算市场）证明，上线时的合约信息能较好预测终身交易量（样本外 R²=0.747），其中市场主题贡献最大；争议风险也可被排序（AUC=0.78），但极低基率下个体预测精度不足（平均精度 0.012）。作者指出，交易量预测性能在平台格式变化后显著下降，且损失主要源于合约特征与需求关系的变化，而非文本到特征的映射过时。上述发现基于特定平台和时间段，外推需谨慎。
keyPointsEn: Launch-time contract information explains most variation in trading volume; market topic is the strongest predictor, while wording and resolution-rule design add smaller measurable gains.
Dispute risk is rankable (AUC 0.78) but at a 0.31% base rate average precision is only 0.012, making case-by-case prediction unreliable.
Platform format change causes large performance drops in volume prediction (AUC from 0.940 to 0.577), with losses concentrated in question forms unseen during training.
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence comes only from Polymarket resolved markets between January 2023 and May 2026, so extrapolation to other platforms or unresolved markets is uncertain; dispute prediction precision is too low for individual forecasts and suitable only for group ranking; volume prediction performance degrades substantially after platform format changes, indicating sensitivity to institutional change.

cards.limitations: 速度提升和扩展性基于作者报告的特定实现与硬件环境；正确性验证仅限于已知DSGE极限；校准实验为概念验证，尚未经过同行评审或独立复现。
cards.originalTitle: JaxMARL-BC: Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Macroeconomic Modelling, in Seconds
cards.whyItMatters: 该工作降低了多智能体强化学习在宏观经济学中的应用门槛，使大规模异质性主体模拟和快速校准成为可能，有助于连接MARL系统与业界信任的DSGE框架。
cards.descriptionEn: New research rewrites the MARL-BC macroeconomic simulator in JAX, achieving 75–724x faster training and scaling to 200,000 independent learning households, cutting calibration experiments from over a month to two hours.
cards.title: JAX加速多智能体宏观模型训练至秒级
cards.summaryEn: JaxMARL-BC is a JAX-accelerated simulator for training multi-agent reinforcement learning macroeconomic models. The authors report training speeds 75–724 times faster than the reference implementation, scaling to 200,000 independent learning households, and completing a calibration experiment in two hours that previously took over a month. Correctness is verified against known DSGE limits, and a simple cost scaling law is characterized.
keyPoints: 训练速度较参考实现提升75至724倍，可扩展到20万独立学习家庭。
模型在特定极限下退化为经典DSGE模型，并以此验证正确性。
通过异质性资本回报扩展模型的校准概念验证，将耗时从超过一个月缩短至两小时。
cards.titleEn: JAX-Accelerated Multi-Agent Macro Model Trains in Seconds
cards.whyItMattersEn: This work lowers the barrier to adopting multi-agent reinforcement learning in macroeconomics, enabling large-scale heterogeneous agent simulations and rapid calibration, and helps connect MARL systems with the trusted DSGE framework.
cards.description: 新研究将MARL-BC宏观经济模拟器用JAX重写，训练速度提升75至724倍，可扩展至20万独立学习家庭，使原本耗时数月的校准实验缩短至两小时。
cards.summary: JaxMARL-BC 是一个 JAX 加速的模拟器，用于训练多智能体强化学习宏观经济模型。作者报告其训练速度比参考实现快 75 至 724 倍，可扩展到 200,000 个独立学习家庭，并在两小时内完成原本需一个多月的校准实验。论文验证了模型在已知 DSGE 极限下的正确性，并提出了简单的成本缩放规律。
keyPointsEn: Training is 75–724x faster than the reference implementation and scales to 200,000 independent learning households.
The model reduces to classic DSGE models in specific limits, which is used to verify correctness.
A proof-of-concept calibration of an extended model with heterogeneous capital returns cuts runtime from over a month to two hours.
cards.limitationsEn: Speedups and scalability are based on the authors' specific implementation and hardware; correctness verification is limited to known DSGE limits; the calibration experiment is a proof of concept and has not been peer-reviewed or independently replicated.

cards.limitations: 证据边界：加速与精度结论基于14个公开基准数据集及特定CPU基线，未覆盖所有数据分布或硬件配置；聚类竞争力仅以Dunn指数与DBSCAN比较，未报告其他聚类指标或参数敏感性；论文未讨论GPU显存上限对可处理规模的实际约束。
cards.originalTitle: GPU-Accelerated Construction of the Gabriel Graph: Parallelization Strategies and Applications to Large-Margin Classification and Graph-Based Clustering
cards.whyItMatters: Gabriel图朴素构建为O(N³)，此前仅适用于数千样本；该工作显著降低构建时间，使基于Gabriel图的大间隔分类和新型图聚类在更大数据集上可行，且聚类方法免除密度半径调参。
cards.descriptionEn: Proposes CUDA parallelization strategies—implicit vertex-pair mapping, bitmask-based atomically compacted edge lists, and thread coarsening—reducing Gabriel graph construction time by two to nearly four orders of magnitude versus a sequential CPU baseline, without loss of classification accuracy on 14 public benchmarks, and enabling a clustering method that requires no explicit density radius.
cards.title: GPU并行加速Gabriel图构建：提速最高8484倍
cards.summaryEn: Fact: The paper introduces three CUDA strategies—linear thread-index implicit mapping to vertex pairs, two-pass bitmask atomic edge-list compaction, and thread coarsening—to accelerate Gabriel graph construction. Fact: On 14 public benchmarks, the GPU implementation achieves up to 8484x speedup over a sequential CPU baseline with no loss of classification accuracy; the proposed clustering method is statistically competitive with DBSCAN on the Dunn index while eliminating the density radius parameter. Author view: These strategies make Gabriel graphs practical at larger scales and extend them to density-aware clustering.
keyPoints: 隐式闭式映射将线性线程索引直接对应顶点对(i,j)，无需O(N²)邻接结构，实现常数时间和常数内存定位。
两遍位掩码原子压缩边表仅生成与实际边数成比例的稠密边数组。
线程粗化让每线程评估多个候选对，权衡启动调度开销与负载均衡。
cards.titleEn: GPU-Parallel Gabriel Graph Construction: Up to 8484x Speedup
cards.whyItMattersEn: Naive Gabriel graph construction is O(N³), previously limiting use to a few thousand samples; this work substantially reduces construction time, making Gabriel-graph-based large-margin classification and a new graph clustering method feasible on larger datasets, with the clustering method avoiding density-radius tuning.
cards.description: 提出CUDA并行策略，消除显式邻接结构、按边压缩存储并引入线程粗化，将Gabriel图构建时间较CPU基线降低2至近4个数量级；在14个公开数据集上分类精度不降，并支撑一种无需密度半径参数的聚类方法。
cards.summary: 事实：论文提出三种CUDA策略（线性线程索引隐式映射顶点对、两遍位掩码原子压缩边表、线程粗化）加速Gabriel图构建。事实：在14个公开基准上，GPU实现较顺序CPU基线加速最高8484倍且分类精度无损；所提聚类方法在Dunn指数上与DBSCAN统计竞争且无需显式密度半径。作者观点：这些策略使Gabriel图在更大规模数据上实用化，并拓展至密度感知聚类。
keyPointsEn: An implicit closed-form mapping assigns each linear thread index directly to a vertex pair (i,j), removing the O(N²) adjacency structure and enabling constant-time, constant-memory pair location.
A two-pass, bitmask-based, atomically compacted edge-list construction produces a dense edge array proportional only to the number of edges actually found.
Thread coarsening lets each thread evaluate several candidate pairs, trading launch and scheduling overhead against load balance.
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence boundary: Speedup and accuracy conclusions are based on 14 public benchmark datasets and a specific CPU baseline, not covering all data distributions or hardware configurations; clustering competitiveness is assessed only via the Dunn index against DBSCAN, without other clustering metrics or parameter sensitivity; the paper does not discuss practical scale limits imposed by GPU memory.

cards.limitations: FinAgentBench 上的端到端 NDCG@5 提升低于该评估的最小可检测效应，统计显著性有限；多智能体协调的损失结论基于特定匹配对设置；标签鲁棒性扫描仅覆盖 16 种替代真值构造；官方排行榜第三名基于排行榜基准，未说明与榜首差距；未报告跨领域或非英语金融文档的泛化性。
cards.originalTitle: PRISM: Prompt-Refined In-Context System Modelling for Financial Retrieval
cards.whyItMatters: 该工作为金融检索提供了一条免微调、可复现的部署路径，并公开评测集与标签鲁棒性分析，有助于在成本、延迟与质量之间做透明权衡；其边界条件研究也提醒从业者避免盲目增加系统复杂度。
cards.descriptionEn: PRISM proposes a training-free framework for financial document retrieval that combines prompt engineering, in-context learning, and a candidate refinement module. It improves Recall@100 on FiQA-2018 and achieves comparable end-to-end NDCG@5 at lower cost on FinAgentBench, while releasing an expert-annotated evaluation set and a 16-variant label-robustness sweep.
cards.title: PRISM：免微调金融检索框架提升召回与成本效率
cards.summaryEn: PRISM is a training-free financial retrieval framework composed of three deployable modules: prompt engineering, in-context learning, and candidate refinement. On FiQA-2018, stacked reranking and k-reciprocal encoding raise Recall@100 from 0.7783 to 0.8326; on FinAgentBench, a Cohere-refined top-50 pool yields a higher observed end-to-end NDCG@5 that is below the evaluation's minimum detectable effect, while cutting per-query cost by about 35%. The authors also release an expert-annotated FinAgentBench evaluation set and a label-robustness sweep over 16 alternative ground-truth constructions, and note that added complexity does not always pay off: k-reciprocal encoding stops helping when the upstream stage is already high-recall, multi-agent coordination is not a default for fine-grained chunk ranking, and matched pairs show multi-agent coordination loses 0.0702 and 0.0681 combined NDCG@5 at the chunk stage.
keyPoints: PRISM 无需微调，在 FiQA-2018 上通过堆叠重排与 k 倒数编码将 Recall@100 从 0.7783 提升至 0.8326。
在 FinAgentBench 上，Cohere 精炼 top-50 池使端到端 NDCG@5 提升但低于最小可检测效应，每查询成本降低约 35%。
多智能体协调在细粒度块排序中并非默认更优，匹配对实验显示其在块阶段损失组合 NDCG@5。
cards.titleEn: PRISM: A Training-Free Financial Retrieval Framework Improving Recall and Cost Efficiency
cards.whyItMattersEn: This work offers a reproducible, training-free deployment path for financial retrieval and releases an evaluation set with label-robustness analysis, helping practitioners make transparent trade-offs among cost, latency, and quality; its boundary-condition study also cautions against blindly adding system complexity.
cards.description: PRISM 提出一种无需微调的金融文档检索框架，组合提示工程、上下文学习与候选精炼模块，在 FiQA-2018 上提升 Recall@100，并在 FinAgentBench 上以更低成本获得相当效果，同时发布专家标注评测集与 16 种标签鲁棒性分析。
cards.summary: PRISM 是一个免微调的金融检索框架，由提示工程、上下文学习和候选精炼三个可部署模块组成。在 FiQA-2018 上，堆叠重排与 k 倒数编码将 Recall@100 从 0.7783 提升至 0.8326；在 FinAgentBench 上，Cohere 精炼的 top-50 池获得更高端到端 NDCG@5，但低于该评估的最小可检测效应，同时每查询成本降低约 35%。作者还发布专家标注的 FinAgentBench 评测集及 16 种替代真值构造的标签鲁棒性扫描，并指出增加复杂度并不总是有益：上游已高召回时 k 倒数编码不再有帮助，多智能体协调并非细粒度块排序的默认选择，匹配对实验显示多智能体协调在块阶段损失 0.0702 和 0.0681 的组合 NDCG@5。
keyPointsEn: PRISM requires no fine-tuning and raises Recall@100 on FiQA-2018 from 0.7783 to 0.8326 via stacked reranking and k-reciprocal encoding.
On FinAgentBench, a Cohere-refined top-50 pool increases end-to-end NDCG@5 but below the minimum detectable effect, while cutting per-query cost by about 35%.
Multi-agent coordination is not default-better for fine-grained chunk ranking; matched pairs show combined NDCG@5 losses at the chunk stage.
cards.limitationsEn: The end-to-end NDCG@5 gain on FinAgentBench is below the evaluation's minimum detectable effect, limiting statistical significance; the multi-agent loss conclusion is based on specific matched-pair settings; the label-robustness sweep covers only 16 alternative ground-truth constructions; the third-place official leaderboard result is leaderboard-basis without a reported gap to the top; generalization to cross-domain or non-English financial documents is not reported.

cards.limitations: 证据基于六个AMLWorld数据集和一个以太坊钓鱼数据集，未涉及其他金融犯罪类型或真实生产环境；TSFM为冻结模型，未探索微调；与最强基线比较，但基线选择范围有限；提升幅度为平均相对值，数据集间可能存在差异。
cards.originalTitle: Leveraging Time-Series Foundation Models for Financial Crime Detection
cards.whyItMatters: 该方法表明时间序列基础模型能捕捉图方法忽略的时间信号，与图结构互补，提升金融犯罪检测效果，同时显著降低训练成本，为实际部署提供可能。
cards.descriptionEn: The study proposes TCEE, a framework that uses a frozen time-series foundation model to summarize account transaction histories and enrich edge representations with temporal context, improving PR-AUC and training speed on multiple anti-money laundering datasets, offering a new approach for financial crime detection.
cards.title: 时间序列基础模型增强金融犯罪检测
cards.summaryEn: Financial crime detection requires identifying rare illicit activities that unfold over time within large transaction networks. Existing graph-based methods capture account relationships but often underuse temporal behavior in transaction histories. The authors introduce Temporal-Context Edge Enrichment (TCEE), which uses a frozen time-series foundation model (TSFM) to summarize account histories and enrich transaction representations, achieving an average relative PR-AUC improvement of 10.8% on five of six AMLWorld datasets and 6x faster training.
keyPoints: TCEE使用冻结TSFM总结账户交易历史，为边分类提供时间上下文特征。
在六个AMLWorld数据集上，TCEE在五个上平均相对提升PR-AUC 10.8%，训练端到端加速6.0倍。
将TCEE表示输入GNN，在四个较小数据集上PR-AUC进一步提升4.8%；在以太坊钓鱼数据集上节点分类PR-AUC提升14.5%。
cards.titleEn: Time-Series Foundation Models Enhance Financial Crime Detection
cards.whyItMattersEn: The method shows that time-series foundation models can capture temporal signals overlooked by graph methods, complementing graph structure to improve financial crime detection while significantly reducing training costs, enabling practical deployment.
cards.description: 该研究提出TCEE框架，利用冻结的时间序列基础模型总结账户交易历史，为交易边提供时间上下文特征，在多个反洗钱数据集上提升了PR-AUC并加速训练，为金融犯罪检测提供了新思路。
cards.summary: 金融犯罪检测需在大型交易网络中识别稀有且随时间展开的非法活动。现有图方法捕获账户关系但常忽视交易历史中的时间行为。作者提出Temporal-Context Edge Enrichment (TCEE)，用冻结的时间序列基础模型（TSFM）总结账户交易历史，丰富交易表示，在六个AMLWorld数据集上平均相对提升PR-AUC 10.8%，训练加速6倍。
keyPointsEn: TCEE uses a frozen TSFM to summarize account transaction histories and provide temporal context features for edge classification.
On six AMLWorld datasets, TCEE improves PR-AUC by an average relative 10.8% on five datasets and achieves 6.0x faster end-to-end training.
Feeding TCEE representations into a GNN further improves PR-AUC by 4.8% on four smaller datasets; on an Ethereum phishing dataset, node classification PR-AUC improves by 14.5%.
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence is based on six AMLWorld datasets and one Ethereum phishing dataset, not covering other financial crime types or real production environments; the TSFM is frozen without fine-tuning; comparison is against the strongest evaluated baselines but baseline scope is limited; improvements are average relative values and may vary across datasets.

cards.limitations: 证据基于作者在CSI 500和S&P 500上的实验，未说明跨市场、跨因子库或样本外时段的稳健性；谱系控制相对基线带来的增益幅度、统计显著性与计算开销未在摘要中量化；因子预测与组合表现不能直接外推为实盘可交易收益，亦不构成投资建议。
cards.originalTitle: Lineage-Aware Search Control for LLM-Based Evolutionary Factor Mining
cards.whyItMatters: 若谱系级控制能稳定改善搜索方向性与多样性，可为LLM驱动的因子挖掘提供除个体和种群之外的新控制层级，有助于减少结构趋同的因子输出并提升搜索效率。
cards.descriptionEn: The study argues that conventional LLM-based evolutionary factor mining lacks lineage-level control, leaving search weakly directed and factors structurally similar. It proposes LineageEvo, which introduces lineage-conditioned LLM variation and lineage-stratified budget allocation to make semantic variation more direction-aware and prevent branch dominance, thereby improving factor predictiveness and lineage/expression diversity on CSI 500 and S&P 500.
cards.title: 谱系感知搜索控制提升LLM进化因子挖掘多样性与预测力
cards.summaryEn: Fact: The authors propose LineageEvo, which adds lineage-level search control to LLM-based evolutionary factor mining via lineage-conditioned LLM variation and lineage-stratified search budget allocation, evaluated on CSI 500 and S&P 500 for factor predictiveness, portfolio performance, search efficiency, and lineage/expression diversity. Author view: lineage can serve as a useful intermediate unit for controlling LLM-based evolutionary factor search, making semantic variation more directed and avoiding excessive branch concentration. Results report that LineageEvo achieves the strongest predictive performance on both markets, while LSPS yields a more balanced lineage distribution and a structurally broader factor pool.
keyPoints: 谱系条件化LLM变异将谱系范围搜索经验蒸馏为算子特定先验，并与全局先验融合，为生成提供持续且与谱系相关的引导。
谱系分层搜索分配在进化中按谱系分配预算，平衡因子质量与谱系集中度，防止单一分支主导。
在CSI 500和S&P 500上，LineageEvo报告最强预测表现，LSPS产生更均衡谱系分布和结构更广的因子池。
cards.titleEn: Lineage-Aware Search Control Improves Diversity and Predictiveness in LLM-Based Evolutionary Factor Mining
cards.whyItMattersEn: If lineage-level control reliably improves search direction and diversity, it offers a new control layer beyond individual and population levels for LLM-driven factor mining, helping reduce structurally convergent factor outputs and improve search efficiency.
cards.description: 该研究指出传统LLM进化因子挖掘因缺乏谱系级控制而搜索方向弱、因子结构趋同，提出LineageEvo在谱系层面引入谱系条件化LLM变异与谱系分层预算分配，使语义变异更具方向性并防止单一分支主导，从而在CSI 500和S&P 500上同时提升因子预测表现与谱系/表达式多样性。
cards.summary: 事实：作者提出LineageEvo，在LLM-based进化因子挖掘中引入谱系级搜索控制，包括谱系条件化的LLM变异和谱系分层的搜索预算分配，并在CSI 500与S&P 500上评估因子预测性、组合表现、搜索效率及谱系/表达式多样性。作者观点：谱系可作为控制LLM进化因子搜索的有效中间单元，使语义变异更有方向性并避免分支过度集中。结果报告LineageEvo在两个市场取得最强预测表现，且LSPS带来更均衡的谱系分布和结构更广的因子池。
keyPointsEn: Lineage-conditioned LLM variation distills Lineage-Scoped Search Experience into operator-specific priors and fuses them with global priors, providing persistent lineage-relevant guidance for generation.

Lineage-stratified search allocation distributes the search budget across lineages during evolution, balancing factor quality against lineage concentration and preventing a single branch from dominating.
On CSI 500 and S&P 500, LineageEvo reports the strongest predictive performance, and LSPS produces a more balanced lineage distribution and a structurally broader factor pool.
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence is based on the authors' experiments on CSI 500 and S&P 500; robustness across markets, factor libraries, or out-of-sample periods is not established. The magnitude, statistical significance, and computational overhead of gains from lineage control relative to baselines are not quantified in the abstract. Factor predictiveness and portfolio performance do not directly imply implementable trading returns and do not constitute investment advice.

cards.limitations: 演示仅基于 10,000 行数据，未涉及大规模数据性能、错误处理、成本或与其他系统的兼容性。该流程依赖 Hugging Face 的 Buckets、Webhooks 和 Jobs 服务，适用性受限于平台功能。
cards.originalTitle: Automate CSV to Parquet with Hugging Face Buckets, Webhooks & Jobs
cards.whyItMatters: 为使用 Hugging Face 存储桶的数据工程师提供了一种无需手动下载和转换的自动化方案，可简化数据预处理流程，提升效率。
cards.descriptionEn: The video demonstrates setting up a webhook on Hugging Face Storage Buckets to automatically trigger a Job that runs a uv script converting CSV to Parquet and writing to another bucket. The novelty is processing files without downloading, useful for data engineers automating pipelines.
cards.title: Hugging Face 桶与 Webhook 自动转换 CSV 为 Parquet
cards.summaryEn: The video shows an automated workflow: a webhook on a Hugging Face bucket triggers a Job that runs optimize-parquet.py to convert newly uploaded CSV to Parquet and write to an output bucket. A 10,000-row slice of NYC taxi data was uploaded, and the triggered Job completed in about 8 seconds. The author's view is that this suits data engineers already using Buckets to automate subsequent processing.
keyPoints: 使用 hf CLI 管理 Hugging Face 存储桶，并设置 Webhook 在文件到达时触发 Job。
Job 运行 uv 脚本 optimize-parquet.py，将 CSV 转换为优化的 Parquet 格式。
演示中上传 10,000 行 NYC taxi CSV，触发的 Job 约 8 秒完成并输出到第二个桶。
cards.titleEn: Automating CSV to Parquet Conversion with Hugging Face Buckets, Webhooks, and Jobs
cards.whyItMattersEn: It provides data engineers using Hugging Face buckets with an automated solution for file conversion without manual downloads, simplifying data preprocessing and improving efficiency.
cards.description: 该视频演示了在 Hugging Face 存储桶上设置 Webhook，当有新文件到达时自动触发 Job 运行 uv 脚本，将 CSV 转换为 Parquet 并写入另一桶。新在于无需下载文件即可自动处理，适合数据工程师实现流水线自动化。
cards.summary: 视频展示了一个自动化流程：通过 Hugging Face 存储桶的 Webhook 触发 Job，运行 optimize-parquet.py 脚本将新上传的 CSV 转换为 Parquet 并写入输出桶。演示中上传了 NYC taxi 数据集的 10,000 行切片，Job 约 8 秒完成。作者观点认为这适合已使用 Buckets 的数据工程师自动化后续处理。
keyPointsEn: Use hf CLI to manage Hugging Face buckets and set up a webhook to trigger a Job when a file arrives.
The Job runs the uv script optimize-parquet.py to convert CSV to optimized Parquet format.
A 10,000-row NYC taxi CSV was uploaded, triggering a Job that completed in about 8 seconds and output to a second bucket.
cards.limitationsEn: The demo only uses 10,000 rows and does not cover large-scale performance, error handling, cost, or compatibility with other systems. The workflow relies on Hugging Face's Buckets, Webhooks, and Jobs services, so its applicability is limited by platform features.

cards.limitations: 实验仅覆盖Gaia2、CostBench和ToolMaze三个基准及Qwen3.5模型系列，结论向其他模型架构、任务领域和真实环境的泛化能力尚未验证；外生事件由合成框架生成，可能无法完全覆盖现实动态的复杂性与不可预测性；性能提升幅度与具体事件设计、轨迹质量相关，缺乏消融分析来分离各组件贡献。
cards.originalTitle: DynaWeave: Learning to Adapt through Dynamic Scenario Synthesis
cards.whyItMatters: 真实部署中的智能体常面临其他用户、服务或突发状况引入的外部事件，而现有训练环境大多只响应智能体自身动作。DynaWeave提供了一种可扩展的自动化方法，将静态任务转化为动态可验证场景，有助于训练智能体在计划失效时重新适应，对提升工具使用型智能体的鲁棒性具有实践意义。
cards.descriptionEn: DynaWeave automatically transforms static tasks into dynamic scenarios with exogenous events, generates verifiable interaction trajectories for supervised fine-tuning, and aims to improve LLM agents' adaptability in changing environments. Experiments show consistent performance gains across multiple benchmarks, offering a practical new approach for agent training.
cards.title: 动态场景合成框架提升LLM智能体适应性
cards.summaryEn: To address the gap that most training environments remain static and fail to reflect external events that invalidate ongoing plans, the authors propose DynaWeave, a framework that uses directed acyclic graphs to represent event dependencies, activates events during agent interaction, and employs a dynamic verifier that revises only checks affected by events that actually occur. Using this framework, they collect 2,095 verified trajectories across 36 environments and perform supervised fine-tuning of Qwen3.5 models; experiments on Gaia2, CostBench, and ToolMaze show consistent overall performance improvements across all evaluated model sizes. The authors argue that dynamic scenario synthesis is a practical approach to training agents to adapt to changing environments, but the conclusions are based on specific models and benchmarks, and cross-environment generalization requires further validation.
keyPoints: DynaWeave将静态任务自动转化为含需求变更、环境状态变化和外部信息更新的可验证动态场景。
框架用有向无环图管理外生事件依赖，动态验证器仅修订受实际发生事件影响的评估检查项。
在36个环境收集2,095条验证轨迹微调Qwen3.5后，三个基准上各模型规模均获整体性能提升。
CostBench任务完成率提升67.34个百分点，ToolMaze上甚至超过Gemini-3.1-Pro-Preview的表现。
cards.titleEn: Dynamic Scenario Synthesis Framework Improves LLM Agent Adaptability
cards.whyItMattersEn: Agents deployed in the real world often face external events introduced by other users, services, or sudden contingencies, while existing training environments mostly respond only to the agent's own actions. DynaWeave provides a scalable automated method to transform static tasks into dynamic verifiable scenarios, which can help train agents to re-adapt when plans fail, with practical significance for improving the robustness of tool-using agents.
cards.description: DynaWeave通过自动将静态任务转化为含外生事件的动态场景，生成可验证的交互轨迹并用于监督微调，以提升LLM智能体在变化环境中的适应能力。其实验显示在多个基准上性能一致提升，为智能体训练提供了可操作的新方法。
cards.summary: 针对现有训练环境大多静态、难以反映外部事件引发计划失效的问题，作者提出DynaWeave框架，利用有向无环图表示事件依赖并在交互中动态激活事件，同时用动态验证器只修订受实际发生事件影响的检查项。基于该框架收集了36个环境中的2,095条验证轨迹，对Qwen3.5模型进行监督微调；在Gaia2、CostBench和ToolMaze上的实验表明各规模模型整体性能均有提升。作者认为动态场景合成是训练智能体适应变化环境的实用途径，但结论基于特定模型与基准，跨环境泛化仍需进一步验证。
keyPointsEn: DynaWeave automatically converts static tasks into verifiable dynamic scenarios involving requirement changes, environment state changes, and external information updates.
The framework uses directed acyclic graphs to manage exogenous event dependencies, and a dynamic verifier revises only evaluation checks affected by events that actually occur.
After fine-tuning Qwen3.5 on 2,095 verified trajectories collected from 36 environments, overall performance improves across all model sizes on three benchmarks.
Task completion rate on CostBench increases by 67.34 percentage points, and on ToolMaze it even exceeds the performance of Gemini-3.1-Pro-Preview.
cards.limitationsEn: Experiments cover only three benchmarks (Gaia2, CostBench, and ToolMaze) and the Qwen3.5 model family; generalization to other model architectures, task domains, and real-world environments has not been validated. Exogenous events are generated by the synthesis framework and may not fully capture the complexity and unpredictability of real-world dynamics. Performance gains may depend on specific event designs and trajectory quality, and ablation analyses separating component contributions are lacking.

cards.limitations: 结论基于一个8.2M参数的Mamba-3模型与八只美股消息流，尚不能推广至其他架构、资产类别或市场状态。R²≈0.59的解码精度与因果可操控性证据均来自作者设定的特征轴与干预方式，未涉及真实交易执行或盈利表现。
cards.originalTitle: Understanding the Inner Workings of a State-Space Foundation Model for Limit Order Books
cards.whyItMatters: 若基础模型内部确实编码了订单流失衡等微观结构变量，研究者可据此缩小可解释性与控制方向，交易场景中的模型行为也更容易被诊断和干预。
cards.descriptionEn: This study examines an 8.2M-parameter Mamba-3 state-space model trained autoregressively on limit order book message streams from eight US equities, finding that order-flow imbalance is linearly decodable from its internal state at R²≈0.59 and that this representation transfers to unseen stocks and extends to traded volume and volatility. It offers empirical clues for interpretability and controllability of market-simulation foundation models.
cards.title: 状态空间基础模型可解码限价订单簿订单流失衡
cards.summaryEn: The authors train an 8.2M-parameter Mamba-3 state-space model to autoregressively generate message streams for eight large-cap US equities. They report that order-flow imbalance is linearly decodable from the model's internal state at R²≈0.59, that this representation transfers to unseen stocks, and that it holds across traded volume and volatility. Pushing the state along a feature's axis is said to shift next-message beliefs monotonically, which the authors interpret as evidence of a world model.
keyPoints: 订单流失衡在模型内部状态中线性可解码，R²约0.59，高于对照与基线。
该表征可迁移至训练中未见的股票，并在成交量和波动率指标上同样成立。
沿特征轴干预内部状态会单调改变模型对下一消息的信念，作者称这与世界模型一致。
cards.titleEn: State-Space Foundation Model for Limit Order Books Encodes Decodable Order-Flow Imbalance
cards.whyItMattersEn: If foundation models internally encode microstructure variables such as order-flow imbalance, researchers can narrow interpretability and control efforts, and model behavior in trading contexts becomes easier to diagnose and intervene on.
cards.description: 该研究检验了一个在八只美股限价订单簿消息流上自回归训练的Mamba-3状态空间模型，发现其内部状态能以R²约0.59线性解码订单流失衡，且该表征可迁移至未见股票并覆盖成交量与波动率。这为理解市场模拟基础模型的可解释性与可控性提供了实证线索。
cards.summary: 研究训练了一个8.2M参数的Mamba-3状态空间模型，自回归生成八只大盘美股的消息流。作者称模型内部状态可线性解码订单流失衡（R²≈0.59），且该表征可迁移至未见股票，并在成交量、波动率等指标上成立。作者进一步通过沿特征轴推动状态，观察到下一消息信念按特征含义单调变化，将其解释为世界模型的出现。
keyPointsEn: Order-flow imbalance is linearly decodable from the model's internal state at R²≈0.59, above controls and baselines.
The representation transfers to stocks unseen during training and holds across traded volume and volatility.
Intervening along a feature axis monotonically shifts next-message beliefs, which the authors say is consistent with a world model.
cards.limitationsEn: Findings are based on one 8.2M-parameter Mamba-3 model and message streams from eight US equities, so they may not generalize to other architectures, asset classes, or market regimes. The R²≈0.59 decoding accuracy and causal steerability evidence depend on the authors' chosen feature axes and interventions, with no test of real trading execution or profitability.

cards.limitations: 证据仅来自单一基准在特定A股数据上的评估，2024年封存测试年份和九款模型的范围有限，结果不宜外推到其他市场、资产类别或更长周期。评估依赖模拟订单簿估计市场冲击，与真实交易环境可能存在偏差。基准排行榜开放提交，不同智能体框架的可比性受实现细节影响。
cards.originalTitle: Quant-Arena: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Quantitative Trading Research
cards.whyItMatters: 该基准把LLM量化研究能力从片段式任务推进到端到端流程，并用封存年份和交易成本约束检验策略的样本外表现。其结果显示模型生成的策略尚未能稳定超越简单等权基准，为后续研究与评测提供了更贴近实盘的参照。
cards.descriptionEn: Existing benchmarks score formulas, code, or single trading decisions, leaving open whether LLMs can complete the full quantitative research loop from hypothesis to executable signal. Quant-Arena provides a benchmark and public leaderboard built on real A-share data: models construct features and stock-scoring code, receive feedback only on 2022–2023, freeze one strategy, and are assessed on the sealed year 2024 with trading constraints and costs, including market impact esti
cards.title: Quant-Arena：面向真实A股数据的端到端量化研究基准
cards.summaryEn: Quant-Arena is an end-to-end quantitative research benchmark that asks LLMs to complete feature construction, stock-scoring code, historical backtesting, and strategy freezing on real A-share data. Models receive feedback only from 2022–2023, and the final strategy is evaluated on the sealed year 2024 using a cash-account evaluator with trading constraints and costs. Among nine frontier models, GPT-6 Astra scores highest, but no model beats the equal-weight market in 2024.
keyPoints: 基准覆盖从假设到可执行信号的完整量化研究闭环，而非仅评测公式或单次决策。
评估使用真实A股数据，2024年为封存测试年，并计入交易约束、成本及基于模拟订单簿的市场冲击。
九款前沿模型中GPT-6 Astra得分最高，但均未在2024年跑赢等权市场。
cards.titleEn: Quant-Arena: An End-to-End Benchmark for LLM Quantitative Research on Real A-Share Data
cards.whyItMattersEn: The benchmark advances LLM quantitative research evaluation from fragment-level tasks to an end-to-end pipeline, and tests out-of-sample strategy performance under a sealed year and trading cost constraints. Its results show that model-generated strategies do not yet reliably outperform a simple equal-weight baseline, providing a more realistic reference for future research and evaluation.
cards.description: 现有基准只评测公式、代码或单次交易决策，无法回答LLM能否完成从假设到可执行信号的完整量化研究闭环。Quant-Arena构建了基于真实A股数据的基准与公开排行榜，要求模型构造特征和选股代码，仅用2022–2023年反馈，冻结策略后在封存的2024年评估，并加入交易约束与成本（含模拟订单簿估计的市场冲击）。该基准对九款前沿模型的测试显示，最佳模型GPT-6 Astra仍未在2024年跑赢等权市场，为评估LLM量化研究能力提供了更接近实盘的检验框架。
cards.summary: Quant-Arena是一个端到端量化研究基准，让LLM在真实A股数据上完成特征构造、选股代码实现、历史回测和策略冻结的完整流程。模型只能获得2022–2023年的反馈，最终策略在封存的2024年用含交易约束与成本的现金账户评估。论文报告九款前沿模型中GPT-6 Astra得分最高，但没有任何模型在2024年跑赢等权市场。
keyPointsEn: The benchmark covers the full quantitative research loop from hypothesis to executable signal, rather than scoring formulas or single decisions alone.
Evaluation uses real A-share data with 2024 as a sealed test year, and incorporates trading constraints, costs, and market impact estimated from a simulated order book.
Among nine frontier models, GPT-6 Astra scores highest, but none beats the equal-weight market in 2024.
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence comes only from a single benchmark evaluated on specific A-share data; the single sealed test year 2024 and the set of nine models limit generalization to other markets, asset classes, or longer horizons. Evaluation relies on a simulated order book for market impact, which may deviate from real trading environments. The leaderboard is open to submissions, and comparability across agent harnesses is affected by implementation details.

cards.limitations: 研究基于连续时间模型与特定假设（如常投资机会下得到闭式解），数值结论仅针对所设定参数与市场环境；纯最小RVAR在α>0时可能将极端坏状态终端财富设为零，这一性质的实际合意性需结合具体约束评估；文中未提供实证检验或样本外表现证据。
cards.originalTitle: Dynamic portfolio selection under range value-at-risk with logarithmic returns
cards.whyItMatters: 该工作为使用区间分位数风险度量（RVAR）进行动态组合选择提供了可处理的理论框架，并说明风险参数如何通过凸包结构改变状态依赖的收益形态，有助于理解RVAR与VaR、ES之间的连续过渡关系。
cards.descriptionEn: The study transforms a continuous-time mean-RVaR portfolio problem into a static quantile problem and characterizes optimal terminal wealth via a convex envelope, revealing state-dependent payoff structures induced by RVaR risk constraints. Its novelty lies in identifying two geometric configurations of the RVaR-specific convex envelope and limiting relationships to VaR and ES, offering a theoretical tool for portfolio design under interval-based quantile risk control.
cards.title: 对数收益下RVAR动态投资组合选择的结构特征
cards.summaryEn: The authors study continuous-time mean-RVaR portfolio selection with performance and risk evaluated in logarithmic returns, reducing the dynamic problem to a static quantile problem and characterizing optimal terminal wealth through an RVaR-specific convex envelope. The convex envelope exhibits two geometric configurations, corresponding to a VaR-type structure and a richer multi-region payoff structure; the RVaR solutions reduce to VaR and ES counterparts under parameter limits. Numerical results show nonlinear and generally non-monotone effects of risk parameters on risky-asset exposure, and pure minimum-RVaR optimization may assign zero terminal wealth in sufficiently bad states when α>0.
keyPoints: 最优终端财富由RVAR特定变换权重函数的凸包刻画，凸包具有两种不同几何配置，对应不同的收益区域结构。
RVAR解在β↓α和α=0时分别退化为VaR解和ES解，建立了三类风险度量的理论联系。
常投资机会下得到闭式财富过程与复制策略；数值显示(α,β,λ)对风险资产暴露的影响非线性且一般非单调。
cards.titleEn: Structural Features of Dynamic Portfolio Selection under RVaR with Logarithmic Returns
cards.whyItMattersEn: The work provides a tractable theoretical framework for dynamic portfolio selection using the interval-based quantile risk measure RVaR and clarifies how risk parameters shape state-dependent payoff structures through the convex envelope, helping to understand the continuous transition among RVaR, VaR, and ES.
cards.description: 该研究在连续时间市场中将均值-RVaR投资组合问题转化为静态分位数问题，并用凸包刻画最优终端财富，揭示RVAR风险约束如何产生状态依赖的收益结构。其新意在于给出RVAR专属凸包的两种几何形态及极限退化关系，为区间分位数风险控制下的组合设计提供理论工具。
cards.summary: 作者研究了对数收益评价下连续时间均值-RVaR投资组合选择，通过分位数表示和拉格朗日优化将动态问题转为静态问题，并用RVAR特定凸包刻画最优终端财富。文章指出凸包存在两种几何配置，分别对应VaR型结构和更丰富的多区域收益结构；当参数退化时，RVAR解可还原为VaR和ES解。数值结果显示风险参数对风险资产暴露的影响非线性且通常非单调，纯最小RVAR优化在α>0时可能在极端坏状态将终端财富设为零。
keyPointsEn: Optimal terminal wealth is characterized by the convex envelope of an RVaR-specific transformed weighting function, which has two distinct geometric configurations corresponding to different payoff region structures.
RVaR solutions reduce to VaR and ES solutions as β↓α and α=0, respectively, establishing theoretical links among the three risk measures.

Closed-form wealth processes and replicating strategies are derived under constant investment opportunities; numerical results show nonlinear and generally non-monotone effects of (α,β,λ) on risky-asset exposure.
cards.limitationsEn: The study relies on a continuous-time model and specific assumptions (e.g., closed-form solutions under constant investment opportunities); numerical conclusions are limited to the chosen parameter settings and market environment. Pure minimum-RVaR optimization with α>0 may assign zero terminal wealth in extreme bad states, whose practical desirability requires evaluation under specific constraints; no empirical tests or out-of-sample performance evidence are provided.
